fields.label: Cache (seconds)
fields.description: How long a person's queue is reused before it is rebuilt from the documents. 0 = always rebuild.

fields.label: Expiry window (days)
fields.description: Batches expiring within this many days appear in the queue. The closest quarter of the window is High priority.

fields.label: Dispatch window (days)
fields.description: Open orders due within this many days appear as awaiting dispatch.

fields.label: Most rows per source
fields.description: A safety limit; when reached, the queue says it is truncated.

fields.label: Rules
fields.description: No rule is active until you enable it and set its hours: the thresholds are Mintree's decision.
